# EPIX3D

> EPIX3D (https://epix3d.com) is a set of online makers for 3D prints. People design in the browser, see the result in 3D, then order a print made in Charleston, SC, or download the print files with a Platinum membership.

## Makers
- [Light box](https://epix3d.com/makers/lightbox/): pictures, text and shapes in a framed box that glows; LED strips glue in through the back cover.
- [Keychain](https://epix3d.com/makers/lightbox/?mode=keychain): a picture or name traced into a flat multi-colour tag with a ring hole.
- [Sign](https://epix3d.com/makers/lightbox/?mode=sign): raised lettering on a plate for doors, desks and shelves.
- [Lithophane](https://epix3d.com/makers/lightbox/?mode=litho): a photo as a thin plate that shows the picture when lit from behind.
- [License plate](https://epix3d.com/makers/license-plate/): custom plate frames and novelty plates with your own text.
- [Nameplate](https://epix3d.com/makers/nameplate/): layered multi-colour nameplates from a subject and style, or your own picture.
- [Hype chain](https://epix3d.com/makers/hype-chain/): a chunky pendant from a logo or text, with a printed chain.

## Plans
- Free: every maker, save up to 50 projects, order prints (each print is quoted per order).
- Platinum: $15 a month; adds 3MF and STL downloads for printing at home.

## Ordering
- Prints are made in Charleston, SC. Checkout runs on the Charleston3D Shopify store, where EPIX3D is sold.
